## 1. 3-Tier CSS Custom Property Contract

```css
:root {
  /* Tier 1: Primitive Tokens */
  --primitive-color-brand-500: oklch(0.65 0.22 260);
  --primitive-color-neutral-900: oklch(0.15 0.02 260);
  --primitive-font-sans: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --primitive-font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

  /* Tier 2: Semantic Tokens */
  --color-surface-base: oklch(0.98 0.01 260);
  --color-surface-elevated: oklch(1 0 0);
  --color-text-primary: var(--primitive-color-neutral-900);
  --color-action-primary: var(--primitive-color-brand-500);

  /* Tier 3: Component Tokens */
  --btn-primary-bg: var(--color-action-primary);
  --btn-primary-text: #ffffff;
  --card-border-radius: 0.75rem;
}
```
